articles.title: Aurora Biennial 2026 Brings 18 Days of Tech-Driven Public Art to Dallas-Fort Worth
articles.summary: Get ready for the multisensory, tech-driven art experience Aurora Biennial 2026 , which has expanded to 18 days across Dallas-Fort Worth. The event will culminate Nov. 21 with an outdoor experiential art exhibition displayed across Dallas City Hall, the J. Erik Jonsson Central Library and the AT&T Discovery District. …

articles.title: Dallas-Based GDT Opens AI Lab Where Businesses Can Test Projects Before Buying Equipment
articles.summary: Dallas-based IT services provider GDT debuted a supercomputer-level AI lab that lets businesses test technology before adopting it. Attendees at the lab’s open house, held at the company’s Dallas headquarters Oct. 22, could watch AI demonstrations and ask GDT executives about AI trends. …

articles.title: Mark Cuban’s Radical Investments Leads $4M Seed Round for Dallas-Based SpendRule
articles.summary: Dallas entrepreneur Mark Cuban’s Radical Investments led a $4 million seed round for Dallas-based SpendRule. The startup’s AI-powered platform matches health care systems’ contracts and invoices. Zeal Capital Partners, based in Washington, D.C., also participated in the round. This round brings total funding to $6 million since its founding in 2025. …

articles.title: SMU-Led Texoma Semiconductor Tech Hub Gets Nearly $29M for Chip Infrastructure, Talent
articles.summary: A regional semiconductor hub led by Southern Methodist University will use nearly $29 million in funding to help bulk up the region’s chip industry. The new funding for the Texoma Semiconductor Tech Hub will go toward developing semiconductor infrastructure, strengthening the semiconductor workforce and commercializing chip technology. …

articles.title: San Antonio leaders will now have to OK every new data center
articles.summary: Every data center developer that wants to build in San Antonio will have to get permission from City Council before it can begin construction.
